name: The Stacking Menu Song
why_it_works: A cumulative song adds one item each round and repeats all the earlier ones, so by the end the viewer has heard the first item four times without being sold to. The growing list also builds anticipation: people stay to see how long it gets.

hook.pattern: Sing the first menu item alone, then promise the list keeps growing.
examples: We tried to sing our whole menu. Here's round one.
Every round adds one. Can you keep up?

variables.name: item_four
variables.description: Fourth item or the big closer

variables.name: offer
variables.example: order the full song for $25 this weekend

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 overhead photo of a single {{item_one}} on a plate centered on a wooden table at {{brand}}, warm light, steam
Vertical overhead photo, the same table now with {{item_two}} added beside the {{item_one}}, warm light
Vertical overhead photo, table now holds {{item_three}}, {{item_two}} and {{item_one}}, slightly crowded, hands reaching in
Vertical quick top-down stop-motion style of the full spread filling the table at {{brand}}, plates sliding in to the beat, 9:16

slides.headline: The {{brand}} menu song
slides.body: Every slide adds one. Sing along.
slides.visual_prompt: Title slide, playful hand-drawn music notes around {{brand}} logo, warm colors

slides.headline: Round one
slides.visual_prompt: Overhead photo of a single {{item_one}} centered on a table

slides.headline: Round two
slides.visual_prompt: Overhead photo with {{item_two}} added beside the {{item_one}}

slides.visual_prompt: Overhead photo with three items, hands reaching in

slides.visual_prompt: Full spread overhead, crowded table, joyful mess

slides.headline: Order the whole song
slides.visual_prompt: End card with {{brand}} logo and the offer in big type

craft.notes: Each round adds one new item at the front and repeats the rest in reverse order, always ending on 'and one {{item_one}}' so the signature item is the resolving title line every time. Keep each item 2-3 syllables with the stress on the first syllable so items fall on the downbeats; speed up the tempo slightly each round (a classic stacking-song trick) so the last round feels like a tongue-twister win. Suggested tempo/feel: start 100 BPM and push to 120 BPM, accordion, guitar or ukulele strum with a kick on every beat.

do_not: Use more than four items; the joke dies if the viewer can't keep up
Put prices in every round; save the money for the CTA
Copy a known traditional cumulative song's exact tune and words
compliance: Med spa: menu items must be real services offered by licensed providers; no results claims or before/after images without a 'results vary' disclaimer; state who performs treatments where required
